title: Credit and Collections Standard — RentGuard Renters Policy Balances
content:
This standard governs what becomes of a credit or debit balance on the premium account of a RentGuard Renters Policy: refunds, write-offs and referral to the collection agency.

## Credit balances

- A refund is issued only when the policy's premium balance, as shown on the policy record, is a credit of at least the tier's refund minimum.
- The refund goes to the named insured by the method of the most recent payment: an EFT payment is refunded to the bank account, a card payment to the card, and a check payment by mailed check.
- A smaller credit stays on account while the policy is live and is written off to 0.00 once the policy has ended.

## Debit balances on an ended policy

- These rules apply once the policy has ended — its status is cancelled or expired.
- A debit balance at or below the tier's write-off ceiling is written off in one write-off entry and is never billed.
- A larger debit balance is billed on a final notice and, if still unpaid, referred to collections.
- An unpaid balance is referred to collections only from the collection referral date that follows the cancellation date. The collection referral date is the cancellation date plus the tier's referral period in calendar days, and referral on that date is allowed.
- A balance is referred at most once. Payments received after referral are still applied to the policy balance.

## Balance outcomes

| Policy | Balance | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| live or ended | credit at or above the refund minimum | refund may be issued by the method of the most recent payment |
| live | credit below the refund minimum | stays on account |
| ended | credit below the refund minimum | written off to 0.00 |
| ended | debit at or below the write-off ceiling | written off in one entry, never billed |
| ended | debit above the write-off ceiling | billed on a final notice; if still unpaid, referred to collections from the referral date |

## Hypothetical cases

- A cancelled policy on a tier with a write-off ceiling of 10.00 shows a debit of 10.00: it is written off. A debit of 10.01 is billed on a final notice.
- A policy cancelled on 1 March on a tier with a 45-day referral period has a referral date of 15 April. An unpaid balance may be referred on 15 April; on 14 April it may not.
- A credit of 0.60 on a live policy with a refund minimum of 1.00 stays on account; a credit of 1.00 may be refunded.
